experiments.scope: The exact blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target, on the instance the harness hashes: one chunk, counter 0, flags 11. One trial per organizer seed runs the search of proof.md 9.1 with 9.8 on 256 batches (1,792 outer steps) drawn from the seed: the whole-class sampler, step CO compiled onto packed words of seven lanes, the widened filter of the nine outcomes of S9 (automaton (2) on omega in every lane, automaton (1) on the Q path; the same masks as the direct tables, Lemma TAB), the E and pass counts against the budgets of 9.1, the pre-check of 9.7, the joint solver of 9.4 with the guards (G7) and (G15) on the outcomes of S, the generic solver of 9.8 with (G7), (G15b) and (G20b) and both guesses of a20 on the outcomes of beta3, and the certificate of every root with the cube, beta and eps of its outcome. Steps 2 and 3 are charged by the block allowances of proof.md Section 11 and tested against the caps 17,504 and C_row. The returned pair is built by step CT on the trial's first passing outer step (its first outer step if none passes), with the one value of E1.c1 for which the counter word that step CT forces is t = 0 (Lemma IP): a 55-byte message and a 63-byte message. Every trial is returned. No BLAKE3 library is imported; the pair is built from the lines of steps CO and CT. SHAKE-256 from the standard library only expands the seed into the batch words. proof.md 9.2 and 9.3 describe the program and its self-test.
experiments.hypothesis: For every trial the two complete 2-round digests (counter 0, flags 11) agree on digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7, the 128 masked bits (Theorem C read at counter 0 and flags 11). The 14 observations are the program's own counts, untrusted and not recomputed by the organizer: outer_steps, passes, s_steps, x3_steps, x3_rows, solver_units, solver_units_max, over_cap, units, roots, certified, verify_fail, halted and pair_step. Expected per trial from the exact shares: about 2.3 passes (SHARE / 2^64 = 0.00127 of the steps), over_cap 0, verify_fail 0, halted 0, and almost always no root; a root on this instance is certified only if its forced counter word is 0. The run is not evidence of attack cost or of a rate. In the participant's local run of 256 seeds: 614 passes, 112 with T not empty, 211 with X_3 not empty, 264 rows of beta3 run, at most 3,987,200 units for steps 2 and 3 of one outer step, no root.
